title: Opening the Gate
description: Leave the village gate, cross the fields and stream, and climb to your first countryside overlook. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

signs.text:
The village gate
Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

rooms.name: The village gate
rooms.lesson: Move · jump · hold Jump for height. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

rooms.name: The open fields
rooms.lesson: The path opens · charge only for the deeper cuts. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

rooms.name: Along the hedgerow
rooms.lesson: Use small jumps beneath the hedge. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

rooms.name: The first stream
rooms.lesson: Land on the broad stones · pause on the bank. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

rooms.name: The hilltop overlook
rooms.lesson: Climb towards the open sky. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.
